fusions.name: Cropping Round
fusions.desc: Takes a mouthful from every enemy within 2.5 tiles, which deals 7 damage and restores 4 health to you. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Cut from the Herd
fusions.desc: A culling blow that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Winter Byre
fusions.desc: Creates a field where you stand for 10 seconds that restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Chores Before Dawn
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (24% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
